title: Rebirth Pub
description:
Rebirth Pub is a unique hybrid game combining pub management, roguelike adventure, and dating simulation. Players must explore dangerous dungeons by day to collect rare ingredients, and operate a pub by night using these resources to generate profit. Develop relationships with charming heroines using the wealth and fame gained through adventure and management, and win true love.

Your life comes to an abrupt end in a sudden accident.
Yet, a benevolent god grants you one final chance.

The new life you choose is that of a small pub owner
in a quiet medieval town.

Within this worn-down tavern, countless stories await—
exciting adventures, new encounters, warm romance,
and secrets hidden in the shadows.

In this second life,
what kind of story will you choose to write?

Nicole• Age: 22 

• Height: 161cm

• Weight: 55kg 

• Measurements: B92(G) / W61 / H95

• Nicole is the protagonist’s step-sister,
who has always been by his side since childhood.
With her bright personality and caring nature,
she actively supports him both in daily life and at the pub.

Though they are family who have spent many years together,
their feelings toward each other have gradually begun to change,
becoming something more than just familial affection.

Look forward to the subtle and sweet shift
growing between the two as their relationship slowly evolves.

Irene• Age: 20

• Height: 153cm 

• Weight: 44kg

• Measurements: B85(E) / W55 / H84

• Irene is a mysterious cat-girl you encounter deep in the forest.
She appears quiet and innocent at first glance,
yet her feelings for the protagonist are the deepest and most intense among all heroines.

Behind her gentle exterior lies a secret no one knows.
A silent obsession, a twisted admiration,
and a dangerous desire she never reveals easily.

She may look pure,
but when it comes to love, Irene is the most dangerous of all.

Serena• Age: 25

• Height: 172cm 

• Weight: 64kg

• Measurements: B110(L) / W65 / H105

• Serena was once the protagonist’s lover.
They shared an intimate bond in the past,
until an incident drove her away from his side.

Now, she returns to him once more.
Their sudden reunion is welcoming,
yet at the same time, deeply unsettling.

Between them remain unresolved memories of the past,
and a present that demands a new choice.

Look forward to the mature and daring love of Serena.

🗺️ AdventureSet out to unexplored areas and engage in combat,
earning Soul Gems and Recipes along the way.
With simple controls, you’ll face waves of enemies,
aiming to survive until the very end.

🍺 Pub ManagementRun a pub together with the heroines and shape each day.
Menu choices, task assignments, and customer interactions
naturally affect the pub’s atmosphere and profits.

💬 Heroine Interaction & CostumesEnjoy a wide range of interactions such as talking, giving gifts, dating, and changing outfits.
Your choices influence relationships,
allowing you to customize your favorite heroine to be even more charming.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Memorable NPCsThe town is filled with unique NPCs.
Meeting them may lead to small events
or unexpected developments.

🎨 High-Quality CG & AnimationsOver 60 high-quality CGs are included.
As your relationships deepen,
special scenes are gradually unlocked.
description_short: After an unexpected death, you are given a second chance. By the will of a god, you are reborn as the owner of a small pub in a quiet medieval town. Explore a new world, meet charming girls, go on adventures, uncover hidden treasures, and save your pub from crisis.
